numeric_complexity_contract.reference: brute force over integer keys: for each shard find the last key in its range already covered by limit kept shards by counting coverage key by key, then fill gaps by a linear walk

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: enumerate every stay/move choice for the movable units and score the protected cities
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: greedy over maximal runs of 1s: a run of L units starting at s > 0 protects any L of the L + 1 cities s - 1 .. s + L - 1, so add their sum minus the minimum; a run at s = 0 protects all its cities
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n) time/O(1) extra space
